trello.name: Fix Android 14 Photo Upload Crash
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Investigate and fix the photo upload crash on Android 14 caused by a NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload. Reproduce by starting a photo upload, backgrounding the app before it finishes, then coming back. Deadline: Fix and verification by Wednesday to allow QA time before the August 20 mobile release.

trello.name: Verify Android 14 Crash Fix on Test Devices
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Confirm the fix for the Android 14 photo upload crash on the Android 14 test devices once Marcus implements it. Add this verification to the regression test run.

trello.name: Build Backend Sync API for Offline Mode
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Develop the backend sync API endpoint that accepts the client's last-synced timestamp and returns a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Implement last-write-wins conflict resolution without a merge UI in this sprint. Deadline: Deliver before August 21 sprint end.

trello.name: Implement Client-side Offline Mode Features
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Implement client-side offline mode for the notes list using local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: user can open app in airplane mode, view and edit notes, and all changes reconcile without data loss when back online.

trello.name: Document Offline Mode Acceptance Criteria
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus and Elena. Write the acceptance criteria for the offline mode ticket clearly stating the expected functionality: offline viewing, editing, and seamless reconciliation upon reconnect.

trello.name: Migrate CI Pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Complete migration of test and release pipelines to GitHub Actions, maintaining the nightly build schedule. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins, ensuring Jenkins remains live until the parallel run is stable.

trello.name: Add Per-user Rate Limiting to Search Endpoint
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Implement per-user rate limiting on the search endpoint to allow 100 requests per minute per user. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when limit is exceeded. Also add metrics counters to monitor users hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update Privacy Policy Consent Screen for GDPR Compliance
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Update the privacy policy screen to have opt-in consent with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, none pre-checked. Obtain new copy from legal. This update is a launch blocker and must be included in the August 20 release.

trello.name: Write Regression Tests for Payments Flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Develop automated regression tests covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths for the payments flow. Integrate these tests into CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.

trello.name: Complete Sync API for Offline Mode and Submit for Review
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Finish development of the sync API backend endpoint and submit it for code review before August 17, prior to planned absence on August 17-18.
